fires.their_rule: no standard mark to compare against; the convention is to draw the higher timeframe's levels, not the agreement

rule_as_data.rule: lean(candles) == lean(upper, at 2) && !(same at n-1)

warmup.before: 60 bars of the chart timeframe and at least 12 resampled bars one step up

reference.quote: Highs & Lows MTF: Allows the user to display previous highs & lows from daily, weekly, & monthly timeframes as significant levels.

draw.today: a dashed segment at the zone's centre from the zone's first bar to the current bar, re-emitted every bar -- the window's 50 events are 50 copies of one band (spans 420 to 469 bars), labelled 'mtf_zone_alignment'
draw.canonical: a band across the zone's own top and bottom, drawn once and extended right while it holds, because the level is the thing two timeframes agree on

fires.our_rule: the newest support/resistance zone's centre is within 0.3% of a resampled (4x) zone's centre; re-emitted on every bar while both hold
fires.their_rule: higher-timeframe levels are drawn as their own set of lines, not as an agreement test against the chart timeframe's zones

rule_as_data.rule: |center(ltf_zone) - center(htf_zone)| <= 0.003 * center(htf_zone)

warmup.before: detect_structure_levels' floor, plus more than 20 HTF bars to resample

reference.reason: SMT divergence is drawn as two correlated instruments' swings with a line between the crack; nothing in the reference set draws it on a single price pane, and this platform has no second series on the chart to connect.

draw.today: nothing: the scan route never emits this concept (it has no EventKind) and no lane in the shell calls /concept-events/smt, so the card shows its hairline and the chart shows no mark
draw.canonical: two panes (or an overlay of the pair) with the diverging swing highs/lows joined, so the crack in correlation is the drawing

fires.our_rule: A's newest lookback-3 swing low is lower while B's is higher (or the mirror on the highs); the two series' newest swings are not required to be contemporaneous
fires.their_rule: the same unconfirmed-lower-high reading between two correlated instruments

rule_as_data.rule: a.newest_swing_low < prior.newest_swing_low && b.newest_swing_low > prior.b.newest_swing_low

warmup.before: lookback*2+4 per series at the gateway's lookback of 3
